additional_gates.finding: monitored_call uses latest owner.groups keyed by worker PGID, with no census completion timestamp or per-PID start identity. Owner publishes groups before later ownership validation. Enumeration exceptions fail closed, but a blocked census can leave a stale snapshot and PID reuse can invalidate earlier membership.
additional_gates.required: Publish one completed immutable snapshot with acquisition/completion timing and process start identities; require its freshness and correct worker/descendant identity at sample acceptance. Add blocked/stale census and reuse/correlation cases. Existing owned/foreign cases do not establish this adversarial boundary.

additional_gates.finding: Constructor failures can leave a retained lifecycle entry with owner.handle=None and owner.done=False after channels are closed or before any native handle exists. close waits to the deadline and cannot confirm retirement; if done becomes true, direct handle methods require guarding. Current actual spawn exception case does not exercise native-handle/capability/channel-construction failures.
additional_gates.required: Represent no-handle/partially-constructed ownership explicitly, close only acquired descriptors, retain genuinely unknown native starts, and collect exact capability/native-create/channel failure outcomes without inventing cleanup success.

additional_gates.finding: events, ticks and signals append without a configured bound. Short collected scenarios do not establish memory/allocation behavior over a3600-second supervision lifetime; repeated cleanup signalling can also grow the list.
additional_gates.required: Use fixed-size recent-event/tick storage with bounded cumulative counters or helper-owned durable evidence, retain deadline/primary-error authority, and validate bounded growth using collected deterministic control cases.

additional_gates.finding: Each Wire.tick may send16KiB and separately receive16KiB. Response correlation does not explicitly require encoder/outgoing buffer completion.
additional_gates.required: Clarify/enforce the combined per-role16KiB budget and complete request transmission before response acceptance; preserve the current finite control bounds and all passing cases.

interpretation: Read-only assessment requested during evidence handoff; these are open source/coverage gates, not newly executed tests or claims of observed live failure. The helper/full-plan acceptance flags were already false. No final aggregate-bound source was changed.
